provider.title: Provider order
provider.description: Comma-separated provider list tried in order (fallback chain). Accepted names: entur, maptiler, nominatim, photon, pelias, motis, transitous, db-ris. Defaults to `maptiler`.

nominatimUrl.title: Nominatim lookup URL
nominatimUrl.description: Base URL used by the orchestrator's OSM-ref place resolver (independent of the provider chain). Defaults to the public OSM instance.
